resources.string: Expand abbreviations as you type, on screen or on a physical keyboard

One shortcut per line: the abbreviation, a space, then the text. Use \\n for a line break. Lines starting with # are ignored.\n\nType the abbreviation followed by a space, Enter or punctuation to expand it. Press Backspace right after to undo. \"Dmq\" and \"DMQ\" give capitalized and upper-case versions.
